title: KNOW-29 roll-up keeps or flags tracked session records when the librarian vault is untracked (#165)
description: KNOW-29 roll-up keeps or flags tracked session records when the librarian vault is untracked (#165)
acceptance_criteria: When the librarian vault directory is untracked or ignored by git, the KNOW-29 roll-up at done keeps a tracked session record in .chough/sessions/archive/ instead of moving it out of the tree, or refuses/warns naming what would leave the tree and how to recover; when the vault is tracked, the roll-up behaves as today. Existing keep-five retention and vault summary behavior are unchanged.
